briefdescription.para: Armv6 introduced instructions to perform 32-bit SIMD operations.

detaileddescription.para: The purpose of this pass is do some IR pattern matching to create ACLE DSP intrinsics, which map on these 32-bit SIMD operations. This pass runs only when unaligned accesses is supported/enabled.
